# Banavaram Charan — Professional Portfolio
> Business Analyst · Data Analyst · Software Developer

## Summary
Banavaram Charan combines business operations, data analysis, and software engineering to build practical, secure, and scalable technology solutions. Experienced in banking operations, financial liabilities, payment reconciliation, Maker-Checker risk controls, and full-stack web application development.

## Current Experience
- Apprentice – Financial Liabilities Operations (WRB), Standard Chartered Bank GBS, Bengaluru, India (October 2025 – Present)
- Core Focus: High-volume financial transactions, 7-gateway payment settlement (Razorpay, Paytm, PayU, CCAvenue, TPSL, BillDesk, Atom), discrepancy investigation, Maker-Checker authorization, deposit servicing, Excel MIS reporting, and process digitization.

## Verified Projects
1. Smart Print: Secure print management platform with QR-code and secure PIN authentication, RBAC, REST APIs, and database architecture (React.js, Node.js, MySQL/PostgreSQL).
2. Block Management Process Digitization: Business analysis and future-state workflow model for financial block actions with Maker-Checker controls, RBAC, and SLA monitoring.
3. Payment Settlement & Reconciliation Process Analysis: Operational framework mapping payment flows across 7 gateways, discrepancy classification, and automated refund checkpoints.
4. Banking Operations Performance Dashboard: Operational intelligence pipeline using SQL transformations and interactive Power BI KPI dashboards for volume and SLA tracking.
